label: EPT taxa richness
field_method: Collect one D-frame net sample (500 micrometer mesh) one meter downstream of each of the 11 transects at the assigned left, center or right station, and composite them. A laboratory identifies a fixed count subsample. The value is the number of mayfly, stonefly and caddisfly taxa.

label: Shannon diversity (H')
field_method: From the same 11-transect composite D-frame net sample (500 micrometer mesh) and laboratory subsample. The value is the Shannon diversity of the taxa counted.

label: Benthic macroinvertebrate MMI
field_method: Computed, not read in the field. From the 11-transect composite D-frame net sample (500 micrometer mesh) and its fixed count laboratory subsample, score EPA's six regional benthic metrics with the published floor and ceiling values and rescale the sum to 0 to 100, as the 2018-19 technical support document describes.

label: Benthic O/E taxa loss ratio
field_method: Computed, not read in the field. From the 11-transect composite D-frame net sample, the taxa EPA's predictive model expects under least-disturbed conditions that were observed, as a share of the number expected. The expectation needs EPA's model, which a new site cannot run.

label: Tolerant individuals (%) ~ HBI
field_method: From the same 11-transect composite D-frame net sample (500 micrometer mesh) and laboratory subsample. The value is the percent of individuals that belong to pollution tolerant taxa.

label: Benthic total taxa richness
field_method: From the same 11-transect composite D-frame net sample (500 micrometer mesh) and laboratory subsample. The value is the total number of taxa.

label: Base-flow index (%)
caveat: Base-flow index is set largely by hydrogeology: a naturally flashy till catchment reads low on this curve without being degraded.
field_method: Base flow index of the watershed, the percent of streamflow that comes from base flow (USGS base flow index grid). DEEP reads it from EPA StreamCat for the reach. Nothing is measured in the field.

label: Base-flow index (%)
caveat: Base-flow index is set largely by hydrogeology: a naturally flashy till catchment reads low on this curve without being degraded.
field_method: Base flow index of the watershed, the percent of streamflow that comes from base flow (USGS base flow index grid). DEEP reads it from EPA StreamCat for the reach. Nothing is measured in the field.

label: Chlorophyll a (ug/L)
field_method: Chlorophyll a of the water column in micrograms per liter, from a 2 L grab sample taken at mid-channel at the X-site in an amber bottle, filtered and analyzed in a laboratory.

label: Specific conductivity (uS/cm)
caveat: Specific conductance carries natural carbonate geology as well as disturbance: a pristine stream in a calcareous valley can score low on this curve.
field_method: Specific conductance in microsiemens per centimeter. NRSA reports the laboratory value of a grab sample taken at mid-channel at the X-site (the center of the reach). A calibrated multi-parameter meter reads the same quantity in the stream at that point.

label: Total nitrogen (mg N/L)
field_method: Total nitrogen in milligrams of nitrogen per liter, laboratory analysis of the unfiltered mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

label: pH (std units)
caveat: pH carries natural geology (calcareous or naturally acidic waters) as well as disturbance, and a two-sided core narrower than measurement precision is noise rather than condition.
field_method: pH of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, as NRSA reports it. A calibrated multi-parameter meter reads pH in the stream at the same point, at 0.5 m depth or mid-depth in shallow water.

label: Total phosphorus (ug/L)
field_method: Total phosphorus in micrograms per liter, laboratory analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site, kept on ice.

label: Turbidity (NTU)
field_method: Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units, laboratory analysis of the mid-channel grab sample from the X-site. Sample before anyone walks the channel upstream.

label: Fish MMI
field_method: Computed, not read in the field. From the upstream electrofishing pass over every habitat between the transects, with every fish identified and counted, score EPA's eight regional fish metrics, several adjusted for watershed area, and rescale to 0 to 100, as the 2018-19 technical support document describes.

label: Simple lithophil fish individuals (%)
field_method: From the same upstream electrofishing pass over every habitat between the transects, with every fish identified and counted. The value is the percent of native individuals that are simple lithophils, spawning on clean coarse substrate without building a nest.

label: Native non-tolerant fish taxa richness
field_method: From the same upstream electrofishing pass over every habitat between the transects, with every fish identified and counted. The value is the number of native taxa that are not classed tolerant.

label: Native non-tolerant fish taxa (%)
field_method: From the same upstream electrofishing pass over every habitat between the transects, with every fish identified and counted. The value is the percent of native taxa that are not classed tolerant.

label: Tolerant native fish individuals (%)
field_method: From the same upstream electrofishing pass over every habitat between the transects, with every fish identified and counted. The value is the percent of native individuals that belong to tolerant taxa.

label: Native fish taxa richness
field_method: Electrofish the sampling reach in an upstream direction, working every habitat between the transects, and identify and count every fish. The value is the number of native taxa.

label: Herbaceous wetland (%)
caveat: Reference bands of hundredths of a percent sit below the land-cover product's wetland-class accuracy, and a steep watershed that never held herbaceous wetland reads low without being degraded.

label: Impervious surface (%)
field_method: Percent of the watershed in impervious surface. DEEP computes it for the delineated watershed. Nothing is measured in the field.

label: Impervious surface (%)
field_method: Percent of the watershed in impervious surface. DEEP computes it for the delineated watershed. Nothing is measured in the field.

label: Woody wetland (%)
caveat: Wetland cover follows terrain: a steep watershed that never held wetland reads low on this curve without being degraded.

label: Wetland (%)
caveat: Wetland cover follows terrain: a steep watershed that never held wetland reads low on this curve without being degraded.
field_method: Percent of the watershed in woody plus herbaceous wetland (NLCD 2019). DEEP reads it from EPA StreamCat for the reach. Nothing is measured in the field.

label: Bankfull width:depth ratio
field_method: At each transect, measure the bankfull width and the bankfull height above the water surface, and the thalweg depth. The value is the mean bankfull width divided by the mean bankfull depth (bankfull height plus thalweg depth).

label: Bankfull width:depth ratio
field_method: At each transect, measure the bankfull width and the bankfull height above the water surface, and the thalweg depth. The value is the mean bankfull width divided by the mean bankfull depth (bankfull height plus thalweg depth).

label: Relative bed stability (log)
field_method: Computed, not read in the field. It is the base 10 logarithm of the ratio of the geometric mean particle diameter to the largest diameter the bankfull flow can move, from the particle count, reach slope, bankfull depth, wood tally and residual pools, with the NRSA physical habitat calculations.

label: Substrate size (log mm)
field_method: From the same 105-particle size class count as sand and fines. The value is the base 10 logarithm of the geometric mean particle diameter in millimeters, computed from the size classes with the NRSA physical habitat calculations.

label: Large wood volume (m3/100m)
field_method: Between each pair of transects, tally every piece of wood at least 10 cm in diameter and 1.5 m long in or above the bankfull channel, by length and diameter class. The value is the wood volume per 100 m of channel, computed from the tally classes.

label: Fast-water / riffle habitat (%)
field_method: At each thalweg station record the channel unit (falls, cascade, rapid, riffle, glide, pool, dry). The value is the percent of stations in fast water (falls, cascade, rapid or riffle).

label: Sand + fines (%)
field_method: Record the size class of the particle at five evenly spaced points across each of the 11 transects and the 10 cross-sections midway between them (105 particles). The value is the percent of particles that are sand or finer.

label: Sand + fines (%)
field_method: Record the size class of the particle at five evenly spaced points across each of the 11 transects and the 10 cross-sections midway between them (105 particles). The value is the percent of particles that are sand or finer.

label: Residual pool depth (cm)
field_method: Measure the thalweg depth at 10 or 15 evenly spaced stations between each pair of transects (100 or 150 along the reach). The value is the mean residual pool depth in centimeters, computed from that depth profile and the reach slope with the NRSA physical habitat calculations.

label: Sinuosity
field_method: Take a compass bearing (backsight) and the distance between each pair of neighboring transects. The value is the channel length along those segments divided by the straight line distance between the ends of the reach.

label: Bank angle (degrees)
field_method: At the left and the right bank of each transect, lay a pole about one meter long against the bank and read its angle from horizontal with a clinometer, in degrees. The value is the mean of the 22 readings.

label: Bankfull height / incision (m)
field_method: At each transect, measure the height of the bankfull elevation above the present water surface in meters, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. The value is the mean of the 11 heights.

label: Bankfull height above channel (m)
field_method: At each transect, measure the height of the bankfull elevation above the present water surface in meters, with a rod at the water's edge and a clinometer held level at bankfull. The value is the mean of the 11 heights.

label: Canopy density, mid-channel (%)
field_method: At mid-channel on each transect, read a convex spherical densiometer facing upstream, downstream, left and right, counting the covered points of 17. The value is the mean of the 44 readings as a percent.

label: Riparian veg cover, woody (frac)
field_method: In a 10 m by 10 m plot on each bank at each transect, estimate the areal cover class of woody vegetation in the canopy, the understory and the ground layer. The value is the summed woody cover of the three layers, averaged over the 22 plots, as a fraction.

label: Embeddedness (%)
field_method: At five evenly spaced points across each of the 11 transects, estimate how much of the particle under the point is buried in sand and finer sediment, in percent. Record the 55 estimates. The value is their mean.

label: Embeddedness (%)
field_method: At five evenly spaced points across each of the 11 transects, estimate how much of the particle under the point is buried in sand and finer sediment, in percent. Record the 55 estimates. The value is their mean.

label: Natural fish cover (frac)
field_method: In the 10 m of channel centered on each transect, estimate the areal cover class of each fish cover type on the form (wood, brush, overhanging vegetation, undercut banks, boulders and the rest). The value is the summed areal cover of the types that are not man-made, averaged over the transects.

label: Road-stream crossings (StreamCat RdCrsWs, API units)
caveat: Units caution: enter the StreamCat API value as served. A crossing density computed by hand in crossings per square kilometer lands about 100 times above this curve.

label: Road density (km/sq km)
field_method: Road length per square kilometer of watershed. DEEP computes it for the delineated watershed. Nothing is measured in the field.
fixed_bands: Good <1 km/km²; Fair 1-<3 km/km²; Poor ≥3 km/km²
